evidence.quote: The International Business Studies programme is completely conducted in English.
Das Studium wird vollständig in englischer Sprache durchgeführt.
The following is valid for applicants from: EU countries non-EU countries For the winter semester: until 15 August
Bewerbung für Internationals 01.04. bis 15.08. via uni-assist
Ausländische und deutsche Studienbewerber_innen, die ihren Schulabschluss oder ihren Hochschulabschluss im Ausland erworben haben (Ausnahme: deutsche Auslandsschule) bewerben sich über uni-assist.

To enrol in the programme, students must have a valid university entrance qualification and provide proof of English language proficiency at a B2 level (accepted certificates according to our Access Regulations).
B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6

note.fr: Vérifiez la date limite exacte et le portail (uni-assist) pour les candidats internationaux sur le site du programme.
note.en: Check the exact deadline and portal (uni-assist) for international applicants on the programme website.

evidence.quote: More information on application periods Please find more details on this website.

notes: The tuition fee is not fully clear: the DAAD page says 'Tuition fees per semester None', but the university pages mention a semester contribution of 434.80 EUR (not a tuition fee). The intake deadline was taken from the DAAD page for non-EU applicants; the university programme page says application for internationals is 01.04 to 15.08, but no year is stated. A semester contribution of 434.80 EUR per semester is mentioned, but it is not a tuition fee. The applicationChannel is uni-assist; no VPD/preliminary review is mentioned on the pages. For the language requirement, the DAAD page states B2 English with an official certificate (e.g., IELTS Academic 6); no other tests are named in the quotes.
